purpose: Precision of the high-confidence tier on the two held-out banks, measured after the freeze. Measurement only: nothing is tuned on it, and the frozen evaluation stays the evaluation of record.
population: high-confidence findings (gap rows, tier high) that match no answer-key row, from the frozen runs ho_centralbank and ho_dhanlaxmi, reconstructed from the model-call cache with the code of tag eval-freeze-2026-10-03
fillers: for each bank, an equal number of pairs the system judged covered (no gap on the obligation), same bank, same seed
order: population and fillers sorted by content key (RBI reference, obligation span, passage span) before sampling; rows shuffled with the same seed
blind: the sheet shows the regulation text, the obligation and the policy passage only; no verdict, tier, type or reason
adjudication: the author labels gap / no gap; every row labelled gap gets the full-policy text check before it counts as a real gap; both figures are reported
